style: STRICT 2D PIXEL CHIBI cozy office game, top-down three-quarter view. Big head including hijab >= one third of full height, target 40 percent; eyes at least 2x3 logical pixels WITH ivory square highlights, never plain dots. Dark plum-brown selective one-pixel outline. Warm readable palette, 3-4 discrete hard-edged shades per material, deliberate chunky square pixel clusters. No smooth vector curves, gradients, anti-aliasing, dithering or realistic rendering. Target 26x46 logical-pixel full body inside 32x64 game cell. Same head size, face, proportions and clothing in every frame. Uniform pure magenta #FF00FF background and generous empty spacing. No magenta in subject, no shadows, furniture, text, grids, punctuation, floating marks or detached props. IDENTITY: Adult woman designer with a soft rounded pear-shaped silhouette. Pastel mint hijab, smooth rounded dome and layered pointed drape framing her cheeks and covering all hair; a small dark sage fold over the shoulder. Warm medium brown skin, round rosy cheeks, large expressive dark brown eyes each with a crisp ivory square highlight. Cream open cardigan with two square pockets over an ankle-length dusty-blue A-line skirt, small dark brown flat shoes. ONE round tan tote with a short rounded handle at her anatomical left hip. The same hijab, cardigan, long skirt and round tote in every pose. Friendly focused smile. No visible hair, trousers, hat, scarf or glasses.
